import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class CodeForce308C_Variant1 {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer tokens = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
        long weight = Long.parseLong(tokens.nextToken());
        long target = Long.parseLong(tokens.nextToken());
        if (weight == 2) {
            System.out.println("YES");
        }
        List<Long> powers = new ArrayList<Long>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
            long val = (long) Math.pow(weight, i);
            if (val > (long) 2 * Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                break;
            }
            powers.add(val);
            int size = powers.size() - 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                powers.add(powers.get(j) + val);
            }
        }
        Collections.sort(powers);
        if (Collections.binarySearch(powers, target) >= 0) {
            System.out.println("YES");
            return;
        }
        for (Long num : powers) {
            if (Collections.binarySearch(powers, num + target) >= 0) {
                System.out.println("YES");
                return;
            }
        }
        System.out.println("NO");
    }
}
